verdict.rationale: Linear documents explicit import capabilities: generic 'Import data from other services into Linear' plus a dedicated Jira migration flow ('Smoothly transition from Jira to Linear') and import tooling for uploading from other systems mentioned in the repo README. This directly satisfies the PM's need to migrate data when switching tools, though detail is thin — missing for 10: specifics on which tools/formats are supported, what data (comments, attachments, custom fields) is preserved, and independent/community confirmation that migrations work smoothly in practice.
